events.verdict: LLB shows Bjelica (SAC) dislodges Anderson (MEM) and affects his ability to get the rebound.
Anderson (MEM) makes marginal contact with Bjelica's (SAC) body during his shot attempt.
Bogdanovic (SAC) makes marginal contact with Mack (MEM) and he is able to maintain control of the ball.
Fox (SAC) cleanly steals the ball from Conley (MEM).
Mack (MEM) makes contact with Fox (SAC) that affects his SQBR.
Gasol (MEM) sets the screen on Hield (SAC) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Cauley-Stein (SAC) and Gasol (MEM) briefly engage and separate off ball.
Gasol (MEM) sets the pick on Fox (SAC) and does not deliver contact.
LAR shows Gasol (MEM) leans into Fox (SAC) on the pick and delivers contact to his hip that affects his ability to defend the play.
[Observable in enhanced video] Anderson (MEM) is in the paint and fails to clear within three seconds.
Conley (MEM) makes some contact with Fox's (SAC) arm, but does not affect his ability to maintain possession of the ball.
Fox (SAC) maintains a legal guarding position during Conley's (MEM) drive.
Anderson (MEM) and Bogdanovic (SAC) briefly engage and separate during the rebound.
Jackson Jr. (MEM) commits a take foul on Cauley-Stein (SAC).
Hield (SAC) makes marginal contact with Gasol's (MEM) body after he releases his shot attempt and does not affect his ability to follow-through naturally.
Jackson Jr. (MEM) commits a take foul on Hield (SAC).
Hield (SAC) makes contact with the ball after it has hit the backboard and has a chance to score.
